data.evidence_summary: StepSequencer is owned by SampleBrowserPage (private member). Primary injection method is applyPatternSet(PatternSet). PatternPreviewDialog returns Result which must be converted to PatternSet. No EventBus topics exist for StepSequencer - direct member access required. Working example exists in learnPatternFromAudio() for dialog usage. No visual flash mechanism exists - pattern application triggers repaint() showing new data.
